parameters.jsCode: const SB_URL='https://kekmppsuiiokdckdeolv.supabase.co';const SB_KEY='process.env.SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY||''';const input=$input.first().json;const headers=input.headers||{};const authHeader=headers.authorization||headers.Authorization||'';const token=authHeader.replace(/^Bearer\s+/i,'').trim();const bodyToken=(input.body||input).token||'';const effectiveToken=token||bodyToken;const tokenKey=effectiveToken.replace(/^sk-/,'');function authError(code,msg){return[{json:{_auth_error:true,error_code:code,message:msg}}]};if(!effectiveToken)return authError('AUTH_INVALID','未注册');try{const tResp=await this.helpers.httpRequest({method:'GET',url:SB_URL+'/rest/v1/tokens?select=id,user_id,status,remain_quota,unlimited_quota&key=eq.'+encodeURIComponent(tokenKey)+'&limit=1',headers:{apikey:SB_KEY,Authorization:'Bearer '+SB_KEY},json:true,returnFullResponse:true,timeout:10000});const rows=tResp.body||[];if(!rows.length)return authError('AUTH_INVALID','未注册');const r=rows[0];if(r.status===4)return authError('AUTH_EXHAUSTED','欠费');if(r.status!==1)return authError('AUTH_DISABLED','禁用');return $input.all().map(function(item){var j=item.json;j._sb_key=SB_KEY;j._sb_url=SB_URL;j._caller_user_id=r.user_id||'';j._caller_token_id=r.id||'';if(j.body&&typeof j.body=='object'){j.body._sb_key=SB_KEY;j.body._sb_url=SB_URL;}return{json:j};});}catch(e){return authError('AUTH_ERROR','认证异常');}
